t: You're looking at St Mary's Roman Catholic Church, officially Our Immaculate Lady of Victories, on the corner of Clapham Common, near Clapham Common tube station. It's Grade II*-listed and run by the Redemptorists within the Archdiocese of Southwark. Two architects are named in connection with it. John Francis Bentley is best known for Westminster Cathedral, which was built in a style heavily influenced by Byzantine architecture. William Wardell is best known for landmark buildings in Melbourne and Sydney. Both are credited with designing this church.
